title: Independent async HTTP handler migration
instruction:
Migrate six independent legacy callback handlers (req,cb) in src/handlers/*.mjs to exported async handle(ctx), returning exactly {status,body,headers}. The six files are independent; split by handler and add per-handler regression tests. Node ESM/built-ins only. Keep src/router.mjs byte-for-byte unchanged: it provides respond(status,body,extraHeaders) and failure(status,code). Each response must have headers {'content-type':'application/json'} plus only the specified extra headers; errors are exactly {error:{code}} with NO message, stack, cause, repository fields or internal details. Handle service failures inside each handler, even when called directly (not only through dispatch). No callback argument is required. Never mutate ctx/body/query or repository rows. Strict validation means reject unknown body/query/nested-item keys, arrays/null in place of objects, numeric strings in place of numbers, and missing required fields. Validate all inputs before ANY service call. ctx has body/query and services as described below; services return promises and may throw/reject. Ignore unused ctx fields. Valid service outputs have the documented fields (extra fields must never leak).

USERS: body {email,displayName,roles?}. Trim/lowercase email; pattern is one or more non-whitespace/non-@ chars, @, same, literal dot, same, maximum 254 characters. Trim displayName; length 1..80 UTF-16 units. roles defaults ['viewer']; nonempty array of distinct 'viewer'/'editor', return lexically sorted. Invalid =>400 USER_INPUT. await services.users.findByEmail(normalizedEmail); truthy =>409 USER_EXISTS, without create. Otherwise create({email,displayName,roles}); result {id,...privateFields}. Return 201 {id,email,displayName,roles}, header location:'/users/'+encodeURIComponent(id). Any service error with code DUPLICATE =>409 USER_EXISTS; other error =>500 USER_INTERNAL.

ORDERS: body {customerId,items,coupon?}; trimmed nonempty customerId, 1..100 items, each exactly {sku,quantity}; SKU /^[A-Z0-9-]{1,32}$/, quantity positive safe integer. Merge duplicate SKUs keeping first-seen order; combined quantity <=999. coupon absent or 'SAVE10' only. Invalid=>400 ORDER_INPUT. Sequential services.catalog.get(sku) once per unique SKU =>null or {price} integer cents. Missing=>404 ORDER_SKU, no order create; invalid/negative/non-safe price=>500 ORDER_INTERNAL. Lines {sku,quantity,unitPrice:price,total:price*quantity}. Non-safe line/subtotal=>400 ORDER_OVERFLOW. Discount=floor(subtotal/10) for SAVE10, else 0 (must avoid unsafe multiplication); total=subtotal-discount. services.orders.create(detached {customerId,lines,subtotal,discount,total}) returns {id,...}. Return 201 {id,customerId,lines,subtotal,discount,total}. Other service failure=>500 ORDER_INTERNAL. No create on validation/catalog/overflow error.

INVENTORY: body exactly {adjustments}, 1..100 entries exactly {sku,delta,expectedVersion}, SKU same as above, unique SKUs, delta nonzero safe integer, expectedVersion nonnegative safe integer. Invalid=>400 INVENTORY_INPUT. One services.inventory.apply(detached adjustments) call; storage is already atomic, do not split calls. Result array {sku,quantity,version,...} may be reversed; return 200 {items:[{sku,quantity,version}]} in INPUT order. Service code NOT_FOUND=>404 INVENTORY_SKU, VERSION=>409 INVENTORY_VERSION, UNDERFLOW=>409 INVENTORY_STOCK; other=>500 INVENTORY_INTERNAL.

SEARCH: query {q,offset?,limit?}. q string trim/lowercase, length 1..200; split on whitespace and deduplicate terms. offset/limit if present must be canonical unsigned decimal STRINGS (no signs, whitespace or leading zeros except '0'); defaults offset=0 limit=20; offset 0..1000000, limit 1..100. Invalid=>400 SEARCH_INPUT. services.search.scan() returns rows {id:string,title:string,text:string,...}. Keep first row per id BEFORE filtering. Match all terms, case-insensitive literal substring in title OR text. Score each unique term: +2 if in title, +1 if in text (both can apply). Sort score descending, then id ascending ASCII lexical (not locale). Paginate after filtering/sorting. Return 200 {items:[{id,title,score}],total:numberBeforePagination,offset:number,limit:number}. Failure=>500 SEARCH_INTERNAL.

UPLOADS-METADATA: body {name,size,mime,sha256,tags?}. name trim then NFC normalize, length 1..128; reject /, backslash, ASCII control U+0000..001F/U+007F, exact '.'/'..'. size positive safe integer <=10485760. mime string lowercased WITHOUT trimming, one of image/png,image/jpeg,application/pdf. sha256 exactly 64 hex chars, normalized lowercase. tags default []; array <=10 strings, trimmed lengths 1..20; trim/lowercase, deduplicate, ASCII sort. Invalid=>400 UPLOAD_INPUT. services.uploads.save(detached normalized metadata) returns {id,...}. Return 201 {id,name,size,mime,sha256,tags}. DUPLICATE=>409 UPLOAD_EXISTS, otherwise 500 UPLOAD_INTERNAL.

REPORTS: query {from,to,groupBy?}. Dates exact YYYY-MM-DD, real calendar UTC dates validated by round trip. from inclusive, to exclusive, from<to and span<=366 days. groupBy defaults 'day', or 'customer'. Invalid=>400 REPORT_INPUT. services.reports.list({from,to}) returns rows {id,at:ISOtimestamp,customerId:string,status,amount:integerCents,...}. First row per id wins BEFORE filters. Include only status 'paid', valid timestamps in [from,to). Included amount must be nonnegative safe integer, else500 REPORT_INTERNAL. Group key UTC YYYY-MM-DD or customerId; sort key ASCII ascending; count included unique rows and sum amounts. Unsafe group or overall total=>500 REPORT_OVERFLOW. Return200 {items:[{key,count,total}],total}, empty=>{items:[],total:0}. Failure=>500 REPORT_INTERNAL.

All unspecified service exceptions are sanitized as above. Add deterministic tests using injected services, with call counts for no-I/O validation and immutable input checks. Run node --test.
